t: Lithuania declared independence on 16 February 1918 and, having lost Vilnius to Poland, made Kaunas its interwar capital.
Occupied and annexed by the Soviet Union in 1940, it was the first Soviet republic to declare independence, in 1990.
Restored Lithuania joined NATO and the European Union in 2004 and the eurozone in 2015.
dyk: Lithuania won the European basketball championships of 1937 and 1939, beginning a national passion for the sport; the 1939 tournament was held in a new hall built in Kaunas.
ev: The Council of Lithuania signs the Act of Independence on 16 February
Polish forces seize Vilnius; Kaunas becomes the temporary capital
Lithuania takes over the Klaipėda Region
A military coup restores Antanas Smetona to power
The Soviet Union occupies and annexes Lithuania
The Supreme Council declares the restoration of independence on 11 March
Soviet troops kill fourteen civilians at the Vilnius television tower
Lithuania joins NATO and the European Union

f.founder: Council of Lithuania (Taryba) under Antanas Smetona
